IS 17424 : Part 1 : 2020 Glossary of Ayurvedic Terminology - Part 1 Standardized Terminology for Fundamental Principles
ICS 01.040.11, 11.020.99
FAD 26
New Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 1) covers description/ definition of terminologies related to Fundamental Principles in Ayurveda. Other standards in the series cover the description/ definition of terminologies related to diagnosis and etiological factors, foods and beverages, medicinal preparations, signs and symptoms, treatment modalities, Pharmacology and Pharmacognosy, structure and function in Ayurveda. The original terms appearing in the text have been transliterated in English and defined for the purpose of clear understanding of the concept by any person who is not an expert in Ayurveda. These terms may be used by manufacturers, researchers, academicians, regulators, clinical practitioners and other enthusiasts interested in the science of Ayurveda.
